sentences.en: The fearful noise astonished anyone coming for the first time.
sentences.zh: 第一次来的人会被那可怕的噪音吓一跳。

sentences.en: What astonishes me is that he never learns his lesson.
sentences.zh: 让我惊讶的是，他从不吸取教训。

sentences.en: The skyscraper's elevators ascend at an astonishing rate of speed.
sentences.zh: 这幢摩天大楼的电梯上升速度令人惊叹。
